_note: Jurisdiction routing table. Hand-authored from constitutional and statutory sources; see README. The router selects a domain, then (if the domain has a disambiguator) one option. Never more than two questions.

disambiguator.question: What kind of road is it?
disambiguator.hint: If you are not sure, pick the closest — we will say what we assumed.

options.label: A road inside a village
options.reason: A village road is a Panchayat subject under the Eleventh Schedule, so this does not go to Delhi.
options.legal_basis: Article 243G and the Eleventh Schedule; local government is Entry 5 of the State List
options.fallback: No online system exists for Panchayat roads anywhere in India. The honest route is the state CM helpline, pre-filled.

options.label: A rural road built under PMGSY
options.reason: PMGSY roads have their own inspection chain under the Ministry of Rural Development.
options.legal_basis: Scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development — no statute

options.label: A street inside a town or city
options.reason: Roads and bridges are a municipal subject under the Twelfth Schedule.
options.legal_basis: Article 243W and the Twelfth Schedule; Entry 5, State List
options.fallback: City portals differ. Where none exists we degrade to the state portal and say so.

options.label: A state highway or a big district road
options.office: Executive Engineer, State Public Works Department
options.reason: Roads other than national highways are a State subject.

options.label: A national highway
options.reason: National highways are a Union subject, so this one genuinely does go to Delhi.
options.legal_basis: Entry 23, Union List; National Highways Act 1956; NHAI Act 1988

options.label: Inside a cantonment
options.reason: Cantonment roads sit with the Cantonment Board under the Ministry of Defence.

infra.water.label: Water supply
infra.water.reason: Water supply is a local body subject, so it is decided at your ward, not centrally.
infra.water.legal_basis: Twelfth Schedule (water supply for domestic, industrial and commercial purposes); Eleventh Schedule for rural drinking water

infra.power.label: Electricity — outage or wrong bill
infra.power.reason: Your distribution company answers first, and there is a statutory forum above it.

money.pf.label: Provident fund — EPFO
money.pf.reason: EPFO handles this through its own grievance system before anything else.
money.pf.legal_basis: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952

identifiers.label: Your UAN
identifiers.hint: 12 digits, on your payslip or the EPFO app.

money.tax_refund.label: Income tax refund
money.tax_refund.office: Centralised Processing Centre, Income Tax Department
money.tax_refund.reason: Refund delays are handled by CPC, and interest on the delay is your statutory right.

money.bank.label: Bank, payment or fraud
money.bank.reason: Your bank gets 30 days first. After that an ombudsman can hear it.
money.bank.legal_basis: Reserve Bank of India Act 1934; RB-IOS 2021

identifiers.label: When you first complained to the bank
identifiers.hint: This decides whether the ombudsman can hear it yet.

supply.ration.label: Ration or PDS
supply.ration.office: District Grievance Redressal Officer under the NFSA
supply.ration.reason: The NFSA gives every district a grievance officer for exactly this.
supply.ration.legal_basis: National Food Security Act 2013, sections 14, 15 and 16
supply.ration.note: One report can create two records: a private case for your own entitlement, and a joinable public case about the shop.

work.mgnrega.label: MGNREGA work or wages
work.mgnrega.reason: MGNREGA has a district ombudsperson with power to pass awards.
work.mgnrega.legal_basis: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005

money.pmkisan.label: PM-KISAN instalment
money.pmkisan.reason: Portal-level issues are fixed at tier one; land seeding and eligibility escalate to the state nodal officer.
money.pmkisan.legal_basis: Central scheme of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

property.housing.label: Builder, flat or property paper
property.housing.reason: RERA has an adjudicating officer who can award compensation, with a 60-day clock.

travel.rail.label: Train or station
travel.rail.reason: RailMadad and helpline 139 handle this, and CPGRAMS is genuinely the correct escalation above it. We say so rather than pretending otherwise.

telecom.service.label: Phone or internet
telecom.service.reason: TRAI requires a two-tier mechanism inside the operator. There is no telecom ombudsman.
telecom.service.legal_basis: TRAI Act 1997; Telecom Consumers Protection Regulations

office.inaction.label: An office is not doing its work
office.inaction.office: The grievance officer of the department concerned
office.inaction.reason: We route to the department's own grievance officer and start the clock.
office.inaction.legal_basis: DARPG Office Memorandum, 23 August 2024 — administrative, not statutory

integrity.bribe.label: Someone demanded money from me
integrity.bribe.office: Chief Vigilance Officer of the department concerned
integrity.bribe.reason: Corruption complaints leave the ordinary grievance workflow.
integrity.bribe.warning: Bribery complaints go to the Vigilance Officer under CVC rules. You will get one acknowledgement and then no updates, and no Action Taken Report is filed. That is the rule, not neglect. You can file with your name withheld from the office.

other.label: Something else
other.reason: We could not place this confidently, so we will say what we are unsure about rather than guess.

none.label: No online route exists
none.note: Honest dead end. We hand over the CM helpline, pre-filled.
